checks: Actual authored ship acceleration, turret targeting and live gunfire render between 15 Hz publications; labels share the same display clock
Pause freezes the exact committed scene and removes the animation loop; zoom still works and resume excludes paused wall time
Temporary read failure freezes at the last known scene and recovers without extrapolated hits or backwards motion
Hidden document stops animation; force reset releases the canvas and the next battle begins with a fresh scene and no prior projectile history
scope: One authored player ship against the prepared opponent; this is presentation validation, not 15–30 ship load acceptance.
